name: Sorcerous Blade
body:
You have learned how to charge a flying blade with a spell, using it to deliver the arcane payload.

Prerequisite(s): summon flying blade class feature, either caster level 3rd or spellstrike class feature.

Benefit(s): You may deliver touch spells via a flying blade as though it was your familiar. This functions as the familiar’s deliver touch spell ability.
